title: allamanda cathartica var. grandiflora
intro: Allamanda cathartica var. grandiflora, commonly known as Yellow Allamanda or Golden Trumpet, is a flowering plant species native to Brazil. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. Therapeutically, Allamanda cathartica var. grandiflora is used to treat various conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-spasmodic actions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and medicinal value.
